hero.title: TEOS Sovereign Root
hero.subtitle: From Alexandria, Egypt.
hero.founded: Founded by Ayman Seif • 125 Sovereign Namespaces • One Root Key • WEB4 Identity Infrastructure
hero.desc1: teos is the master root credential of the TEOS ecosystem. It serves as the foundation for sovereign country identities and next-generation digital ownership.
hero.desc2: This is not a domain marketplace. We do not sell domains. We distribute sovereign identity keys that enable participation in the WEB4 ecosystem.
hero.cta: Claim your sovereign identity. Own your name across 125 nations.

pricing.how1: .teos is the root key. A country name such as saloma.eg only unlocks if the wallet has saloma.teos, either in same purchase or already owned. Server enforces this.
pricing.how2: After .teos, buyer can unlock 124 country domains. List in tlds/all.json
pricing.price5: $10 for 5+ letter names while fewer than 100 sold on that TLD. After that $30
pricing.ownership: Every name is a Metaplex Core asset on Solana, owned by buyer wallet. No renewal fee, tradable from Phantom, Solflare, Backpack
